message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout and I was totally ready for it—thanks to my gloriously over-prepared self! I grabbed my trusty lantern and power bank, while my kids were marveling at the sudden dark. We huddled together, shared stories, and even made up a few silly ones about a ‘candle-eating monster’ (which, of course, we didn’t have!). The whole thing turned into a cozy adventure rather than a hassle. So, here's my tip: keep those flashlights charged and have a fun plan for when the lights go out! What’s your go-to blackout trick? 💡
